newsitem.title: UK: London gold fixes just lower, PGMs firmer.
newsitem.headline: London gold fixes just lower, PGMs firmer.

text.p: GOLD - Fixed at $343.70 vs $343.75 previously. Fairly quiet and forecast to drift lower. Little upside potential short term.
SILVER - Barely changed at $4.77/$4.79, down a cent.
PLATINUM - $457.00/$462.00 up $16.90. Some buying, market panic of last week receding.
PALLADIUM - Also firmer on support from Tokyo. $218.00/$223.00, up $12.40.
